01 • About me

A little story about me.

My name is Priyanshi Pandeya, and I am from Nepal. I am currently studying Business Administration at Dong-A University in Busan, South Korea.

Studying abroad has helped me become more independent, adaptable, and open-minded. I enjoy learning about business and management while experiencing a new culture.

Exploring nature is one of my favorite hobbies. I love peaceful views, new places, photography, and small moments that make everyday life memorable.
